name: Split
tagline: Ancient Roman Palace Meets Adriatic Beach Life
description: Split is Croatia's second city, built in and around the ruins of Diocletian's Palace on the stunning Dalmatian coast. The combination of Roman history, crystal-clear Adriatic waters, Mediterranean cuisine, and a cost of living below Western Europe makes it an increasingly popular destination for expats and retirees. Island hopping to Hvar, Brač, and Vis is a way of life here, and the city's cafe culture and outdoor lifestyle are hard to resist.

quickFacts.visa: Schengen visa rules (90 days); digital nomad visa available (1 year)
quickFacts.language: Croatian, English widely spoken especially among younger generation
quickFacts.safetyRating: High – very safe city with low crime rates
quickFacts.climate: Mediterranean with hot dry summers and mild wet winters

housing.description: Room in a shared flat / micro-studio, outer neighborhood (Split 3, Kman, Sućidar, Spinut fringe)

dining.description: Mostly home cooking with konoba grilled fish and ćevapi a few nights a week and a Riva coffee ritual

healthcare.description: Minimum compliant private plan meeting the residence-permit insurance requirement

entertainment.description: Free beach days at Bačvice, Marjan Hill hikes and cultural events in Diocletian's Palace

1M.lifestyle: A room in a shared flat or a micro-studio in an outer neighborhood like Split 3, Kman, or the Spinut fringe, walkable or a short bus ride to the center. Konoba meals of grilled fish and ćevapi a few nights a week, a morning coffee ritual on the Riva, and free beach days at Bačvice and hikes up Marjan Hill. The Promet bus pass covers the outer districts, and a permit-compliant private health policy is carried. The main friction is finding a reliable year-round rental, since many landlords prefer summer tourist income.

housing.description: Own studio/small 1BR outside the historic center (Lovret, Spinut, Bačvice-adjacent)

dining.description: Adriatic seafood restaurants and wine bars regularly

healthcare.description: Comprehensive private plan, Split private-clinic access

entertainment.description: Island-hopping to Hvar and Brač, sailing courses and wine tours

2M.lifestyle: A studio or small one-bedroom near the Old Town or in Žnjan with sea views. Regular dining at Adriatic seafood restaurants and wine bars, comprehensive private cover, and a car for coastal drives. Weekend catamaran ferries to Hvar and Brač are easy and cheap. Split delivers a genuine Mediterranean rhythm at well below the cost of comparable Italian or French coastal cities.

housing.description: 1BR in a desirable central district (Varoš, Bačvice, Riva-adjacent Grad)

dining.description: Top Dalmatian tables like Dvor and Zoi, premium wine

healthcare.description: Broad-network private plan, fuller specialist/elective cover

transportation.description: Pass + car for coastal drives + catamaran ferries

entertainment.description: Private sailing trips and exclusive island experiences

3M.lifestyle: A one-bedroom in a desirable central district — Varoš, Bačvice, or Riva-adjacent Grad. Regular dining at top Dalmatian restaurants like Dvor and Zoi, a broad-network private plan with EU-wide coverage, and a car plus seasonal boat rentals for island visits. European travel fits easily. The restaurant scene is growing but still smaller than a big city's, and this budget carries a real margin.

housing.description: High-spec / renovated central 1BR, old-town-adjacent or sea-view

healthcare.description: Premium plan with entry-level international (regional/EU) cover

entertainment.description: Private yacht excursions and European cultural tours

luxuryExtras.description: Adriatic yacht cruises / Dalmatian property interests / art

5M.lifestyle: A high-spec central one-bedroom in a premium building, old-town-adjacent or with a sea view. Near-daily dining across Dalmatia, premium private cover with access to top EU hospitals, regular housekeeping, and a sailboat or motorboat. First-class European travel is routine. The coast and islands are the main draw, and the budget leaves a large margin given Split's cost base.

housing.description: Luxury 1–2BR at a prime address (Varoš stone house, Bačvice seafront, Meje/Marjan slope)

dining.description: Private-chef-level dining and catered Adriatic events

healthcare.description: Top-tier worldwide cover (Cigna Global / Bupa Global) with evacuation

transportation.description: Premium car + private transfers + boat charters + flights across Europe

entertainment.description: Private Adriatic yacht cruises, art patronage and exclusive events

luxuryExtras.description: Regular boat charters, fine wine, generous giving

10M.lifestyle: A luxury one-to-two-bedroom at a prime address — a Varoš stone house, a Bačvice seafront flat, or the Meje/Marjan slope. Private-chef-level dining, top-tier international health cover, a premium car with private transfers and a driver for occasions, and housekeeping several days a week, with regular boat charters for Adriatic cruising. As a mid-sized city, Split offers limited ways to spend this much locally, so frequent travel becomes part of the lifestyle by default.
